title: The Bridge of the Palatinate
author: Wendell Halloran
blurb: Astrid Ravensworth, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
